original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克：SERNIC再通报一名涉嫌杀害主教奥索里奥·西托拉·阿丰索的嫌疑人被捕
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 莫桑比克赞比西亚省国家刑事调查局（SERNIC）周三向媒体通报一名46岁男子，该男子被指涉嫌参与2026年6月6日杀害克利马内教区前主教多姆·奥索里奥·西托拉·阿丰索一案。该男子于10月29日被拘留，使此案被拘留人数增至六人，包括两名神父、一名保安和三名平民。当局同时展示一支AKM枪械、弹匣及23发弹药，警方称这些物证可能有助于厘清案情。

key_facts.fact: SERNIC在赞比西亚省向媒体通报一名46岁男子，其被指涉嫌参与杀害前主教奥索里奥·西托拉·阿丰索
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The National Criminal Investigation Service (SERNIC) in Zambézia presented a 46-year-old man to the press on Wednesday, who is alleged to have been involved in the murder of the former Bishop of the Diocese of Quelimane, Dom Osório Citora Afonso

key_facts.fact: 该男子于10月29日被拘留，此案被拘留人数增至六人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The man was detained on 29 October. His detention brings the number of people detained in connection with the case to six

key_facts.fact: 被拘留者包括两名神父、一名保安和三名平民
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: two priests and a security guard, all linked to the diocese, and three civilians

key_facts.fact: 当局展示一支AKM枪械、弹匣及23发弹药，警方称可能有助于厘清案情
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: presented by the authorities alongside an AKM firearm, accompanied by a magazine and 23 rounds of ammunition. According to the police, the material could help clarify the case

uncertainties: 该男子涉案情况为据称/被指，尚未经证实
